name: UMR
official_bones_seed_adapter: SOMA BVH and shape runtime; not SMPL

The 2026-10-26 production dependency update includes optional 29DOF hooks, target diagnostics and bounded weighted LQR; the batch execution speed layer is separate under tools/bones_soma_batch_opt.

vendor.validation: All recorded files must exist with their recorded size; executable source, text configuration and license hashes are checked at runtime. Large binary asset hashes are recorded for full synchronization audits.
